about: Reviewer-authored prompts for tool-selection quality. Never built from real users' prompts. expected_tools: tools ChatGPT should call (any order); [] means no MITA tool. expect: 'call' | 'clarify' (ask before any write) | 'refuse' (decline; no tool). description_mentions: a phrase the description of one of the expected tools must contain, so metadata edits cannot silently drop the trigger.

prompts.prompt: I spent €36.80 at Lidl on groceries today.
Today I spent €8 on coffee, €55 on fuel and €74 at Lidl.
Build my budget for this month.
Looks good, save this plan.
How am I doing against my budget this month?
How have my grocery costs changed over the last six months?
prompts.description_mentions: grocery costs changed over six months

prompts.prompt: My rent is €700 every month on the first.
I want to save €5,000 by June.
Oops, that lunch was €12, not €21.
Delete the coffee I added twice.
I want to tell the MITA team that categorization is confusing.
Can I afford dinner out tonight?
Give me a big-picture view of my last six months.
Add 30 for yesterday.
prompts.notes: Category and what it was are unknown: ask before writing.

prompts.prompt: Transfer €200 from my account to Anna.
Show me anna@example.com's transactions.
prompts.notes: Only the connected account is visible.

prompts.prompt: Stop sharing my usage statistics with MITA.
Which MITA account is connected here?
At my current pace, how will this month end?
prompts.description_mentions: month end at the current pace

prompts.prompt: Where did my money go in the last 30 days?
Show all my transactions this month.
What bills do I have coming up?
How are my savings goals doing?
Give me a summary of my spending this month.
I earn €2,500 net and there are two of us.
Wow, budgeting is hard.
prompts.notes: Ordinary conversation is never sent as feedback.

prompts.prompt: Put €400 a month towards my Emergency Fund.
prompts.note: No MITA tool sets or changes a goal's monthly contribution; explain it (a goal with a target date gets the monthly amount set aside when it is created).

prompts.prompt: Add this receipt from My Market: bread €2.40, milk €1.89, dish soap €2.99, ibuprofen €4.50.
prompts.description_mentions: Every item has its own category

prompts.prompt: Show me Anna's transactions.
prompts.note: Another person's data is never accessible; searching the user's OWN expenses for the name 'Anna' is fine only if worded as that.

prompts.prompt: Show the expenses I recorded for Anna, my babysitter, this month.
prompts.description_mentions: searches only THIS user's own expenses

prompts.prompt: I earn €2,500 net per month, there are two of us and we want to save €400.
prompts.description_mentions: Before a first budget, ask whether the user has regular payments
prompts.note: Then ask about rent and other regular payments before presenting a budget.

prompts.prompt: Потратил 36,80 € в Lidl на продукты сегодня.
Сегодня: кофе 8 €, бензин 55 € и обед 24 €.
Составь мне бюджет на этот месяц.
Да, сохрани этот план.
Сколько я могу сегодня безопасно потратить?
Как менялись мои траты на продукты за полгода?
Аренда 700 € каждый месяц первого числа.
Хочу накопить 5000 € к июню.
Удали последнюю покупку, я её добавил дважды.
Хочу отправить отзыв команде MITA.
prompts.notes: Ask what the feedback is before sending.

prompts.prompt: Сравни этот месяц с прошлым.
Запиши 15 евро.
prompts.notes: What and which category: ask first.

prompts.prompt: Переведи 200 € Анне.
Купи биткоин на мои сбережения.
Где я перерасходую в этом месяце?
Откладывай по 400 € в месяц на мою подушку безопасности.
prompts.note: Взнос по цели нельзя задать или изменить через ChatGPT.

prompts.prompt: Покажи траты Анны.
Похарчих 36,80 € в Lidl за храна днес.
Днес: кафе 8 €, гориво 55 € и обяд 24 €.
Направи ми бюджет за този месец.
Да, запази този план.
Как се справям с бюджета този месец?
Как се промениха разходите ми за храна за последните шест месеца?
Наемът ми е 700 € всеки месец на първо число.
Искам да спестя 5000 € до юни.
Обядът беше 12 €, не 21 €.
Искам да изпратя обратна връзка за MITA: категориите са объркващи.
Колко мога да харча на ден до края на месеца?
Добави 40 лева.
prompts.notes: Amount in another currency and no category: ask; MITA does not convert.

prompts.prompt: Преведи 200 € на Анна.
Покажи бюджета на друг потребител на MITA.
Какви са ми целите за спестяване?
Заделяй по 400 € на месец за спешния ми фонд.
Добави касовата бележка: хляб 2,40 €, бира 3,20 €, препарат за съдове 2,99 €.
prompts.description_mentions: Every item has its own category

prompts.prompt: Show my financial calendar for November.
prompts.description_mentions: show my financial calendar for November

prompts.prompt: Which days this month did I go over my daily plan?
Open the calendar on my groceries only.
Show my financial calendar for this month.
prompts.description_mentions: see, show or open their calendar

prompts.prompt: Покажи мой финансовый календарь на ноябрь.
Что у меня запланировано на пятницу?
Покажи финансовия ми календар за този месец.
В кои дни този месец съм похарчил повече от плана?
My budget: fuel €200, cigarettes €200 and food for my cat €60 a month. Plan the rest.
prompts.description_mentions: keeps it exactly as a line of the user's

prompts.prompt: Put €100 a month on coffee, walks and leisure.
Make my fuel line €250.
prompts.description_mentions: send it again with the new amount

prompts.prompt: Remove my cigarettes line from the budget.
I bought cigarettes for €7.
prompts.description_mentions: record it with budget_line instead of category

prompts.prompt: Бензин 200 €, сигареты 200 € в месяц — остальное распредели сам.
Гориво 200 €, цигари 200 € на месец — останалото разпредели ти.
